chatSession.title: ChatSession
chatSession.description: Represents a distinct conversation thread created by a user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this chat session.

title.description: The human-readable title of this conversation thread.

createdAt.description: The server-generated timestamp when this session was initialized.

updatedAt.description: The server-generated timestamp when this session was last modified.

chatMessage.title: ChatMessage
chatMessage.description: Represents an individual text statement exchanged within a chat session.

userId.description: The UID of the user who composed this message or initiated the prompt.

role.description: The role of the communicator, either the user or the assistant model.

content.description: The actual text body of the chat message.

createdAt.description: The server-generated timestamp when the message was sent.

chatSessions/{chatSessionId}.description: A top-level collection containing all conversational sessions.

chatSessions/{chatSessionId}/messages/{m.description: A sub-collection holding individual statements exchanged within a specific session.
